notes.title: The 3rd hotfix is now live!
notes.content:

- Password-protected servers.
- Fixed game being randomly unresponsive/crashing when riding Polaris and some retro sleds. Probability was highest when riding north/east on Woodland or High Peaks.
- Utility sleds balancing.
- Skis were not turning for other players in multiplayer.

- Few watchtowers did not have colliders.
- Removed visual duplicate rear suspension parts from Shredders.

- Corrected Kitty stats bars.
- SKS minor visual fix.

notes.title: Community Spotlight ExHiiBiT
notes.content:
[h2]Meet Josh, AKA ExHiiBiT
[/h2]
Hey, everyone! I'm Josh, also known as [b]ExHiiBiT[/b], and I've been on this journey of content creation for about three years now. While my YouTube channel has videos dating back to 2016, it wasn't until the Covid hit that I went all in. Working from home freed up a lot of my time, and here we are! I've found my niche in the motorsports genre, with [b]Motocross taking center stage[/b]. Creating content was a dream of mine. It's fascinating how life takes unexpected turns. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657742/70625b181878f32615ca3064606d87c0904c7466.png[/img]

Sledders entered my world thanks to my friend Kelton, who dropped it into a chat. Who knows if I would've stumbled upon this thrilling snowmobiling adventure without him! The challenge of learning drew me in. As someone who [b]had never been on a snowmobile[/b] before, figuring out the controls and mastering the game became the exciting part of the journey – not to mention snocross!


[h3]Favorite Game
[/h3]When I'm not conquering the mountains in Sledders, [b]my go-to game is Mx Bikes[/b]. It's a motocross enthusiast's dream, offering a realistic experience of Motocross. For fellow motocross nerds out there, [b]it's a must-play[/b].

[h3]Fun fact about me
[/h3][b]I raced in the KTM Junior Supercross[/b]. Those motocross roots run deep, and my experiences on the track have undoubtedly influenced my love for motorsports gaming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657742/9ff5d44041c6aeec4b38ffc419b0126fe6103bf2.png[/img]

[h3]Words of Wisdom for Aspiring Content Creators
[/h3]If you're thinking about diving into the world of content creation, here's some advice from my journey – don't give up! Consistency is key, and authenticity is your superpower. Don't be afraid of what others might think. [b]Just be yourself[/b], and you'll attract a community that appreciates you for who you are.

Apart from YouTube, you can catch me on TikTok and Instagram, both under the name ExHiiBiT. 

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ExHiiBiT

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@exhiibit

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/exhiibitreels/

notes.title: Sledders Development Roadmap 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is an overall view of the 2024 Roadmap and a few words on where we are heading with Sledders.

Nothing is written in stone, and we keep evolving and finding the best features for this unique snowmobiling game. We want to keep the community close and do our best.

That said, it is 100% certain that not all feature requests from the community will end up in the game. Some ideas are too time-consuming and will probably take many years to develop. Still, the Sledders community is a crucial source of inspiration, and all ideas are welcome.


[h3]So, what are we going to do with the game?
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Physic fine-tuning, Re-work on Skis and front suspension
[*] Character development, Female driver, Transition animations, Possibility to hop-over when side-hilling
[*] Gameplay features - Singleplayer & Multiplayer; Progressive gameplay, Explore and Unlock items, Challenge your friends in different multiplayer modes.
[*] New Garage/Garage UI; Character/Sled customization -> Parts & Tuning, Stats, Wraps, Outfits
[*] Level/map development
[*] Compacted snow / Hard surface driving -> Snowcross, Trails, Jumps
[*] Sound development
[/list]

We are looking forward to making this the best snowmobiling gaming experience there ever has been. We will showcase new features in the future.

After the core game is ready we will look into mod support. This will probably take place in 2025. 

Stay tuned for updates! The game will improve through the year 2024!

notes.title: Community Spotlight - Lynds
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657742/8c9d60ba4fff1e271d47f0d6762007d7297b50a1.png[/img]

[h3]Discover the world of Lynds, a dedicated content creator with a knack for MX gaming and more. In this edition of Community Spotlight, we delve into the insights, experiences, and journey that led Lynds to become an integral part of the Sledders community.[/h3]

[b]Q: Tell us about yourself[/b]
I've been making YouTube videos for 2 1/2 years, primarily centered around MX gaming but I occasionally give as hot other games as well. What started as a post-work hobby became into a full-time job. I've always wanted to create content since my youth, but it took some courage to began uploading my videos.

[b]Q: How did you get into content creation?[/b]
It all began after stumbling upon a quick 2-minute gameplay video from another MX Bikes player, back when the rider was just an orb. 

[b]Q: What do you enjoy most about the game?[/b]
Getting together with a group of people and finding new things to do. Looking forward to having more dedicated areas across the maps like the snocross, etc

[b]Q: Share a random fact about yourself[/b]
During my younger days, I went through a phase where I only used plastic cutlery. A quirky detail that adds a touch of personality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657742/4677a431d45200e4d275db4f19613f3c064ed966.png[/img]

[b]Q: Favorite game and a piece of advice for aspiring content creators[/b]
MX Bikes takes the top spot with 2800 hours of gameplay. It's a game that keeps me coming back, providing both frustration and the drive to improve. For aspiring creators: Consistency is key. Keep showing up every day, and your audience will find you, making you a part of their daily routine.

Follow Lynds on TikTok and also on YouTube for a blend of MX gaming and more.

notes.title: NEWS FLASH: Sledders Joins the Lineup at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]We're excited to announce that Sledders, will be taking center stage at the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 
[/h3]

Get ready to immerse yourself in the frosty world of Sledders and experience the heart-pounding action, jaw-dropping stunts, and thrilling races that await you.

[h3]Steam Next Fest Dates: October 9th to 16th, 2023 @10:00AM Pacific
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657742/197270edbc9c53eb557e1ebb84bad0eed7b99315.gif[/img]

[b]About Sledders
[/b]Sledders have been in pre-alpha for 2023, and its active, 20,000-strong Discord community has most recently gone wild for the brand-new rider character which dropped along with the latest update. Now we are ready to bring game to more players as a form of a Steam demo. 

[b]About developer
[/b]Hanki Games is a Indie game studio based in Kuopio, eastern Finland, which was born out of the need of its founder’s snowmobiling hobby to be continued in summertime. The studio employs currently two people in addition to its founder, and hopes to grow with Sledders as a prominent Finnish development house.
